faq_heading: Surrey golf course homes: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Surrey golf course home cost?
faq.a: Across 78 Surrey closings from November 2025 through August 2026, the golf course median came to $1,405,000, with the middle half between $1,221,250 and $1,603,750. All Surrey detached houses had a median of $1,300,500.

faq.q: What counts as a golf course home in Surrey?
faq.a: In Paragon the agent who lists the house picks Golf Course Nearby or Golf Course Dev. under Site Influences, so Surrey homes beside a fairway and homes a short walk away can both appear.

faq.q: How fast do Surrey golf course homes sell?
faq.a: The median was 34 days on the market, closing at 95.5% of list, with 5% over the list price. All Surrey houses took 32 days.

faq.q: Which Surrey neighbourhoods have the most golf course homes?
faq.a: Fleetwood Tynehead had 28 sales with the flag, East Newton 16 and Bear Creek Green Timbers 8 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

Use this search to see Surrey detached houses currently for sale where the listing flags a golf course on the street or nearby. The most golf course sales were in Fleetwood Tynehead (28), East Newton (16) and Bear Creek Green Timbers (8).

Between November 1 and August 31, Surrey recorded 785 detached house sales, and 78 of them (10%) had the flag. The median was $1,405,000, which is 8% above the $1,300,500 median across all Surrey houses.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a Surrey golf course home

items.t: Find out how far the house is from the course and whether the back or the side faces it. The flag showed up on 78 Surrey sales, so it covers a wide range of lots. Fleetwood Tynehead had the most flagged sales (28).

Check the windows, siding and fence on the course side for ball marks, and ask the seller whether there was damage, a claim or netting. The typical house was built in 1992, which tells you how old the roof and windows facing the course may be.

Order the title search to see whether a right-of-way, covenant or building setback is registered against the lot. The flag appeared on 10% of Surrey house sales, so ask your agent which registered documents apply on Fleetwood Tynehead streets.
See the house early in the morning and again in the evening, since course maintenance and play change the noise. They took 34 days to sell at a median, which leaves room for a second visit.
Set the price against nearby houses with no flag. The medians were $1,405,000 with it and $1,300,500 without, and floor area and age explain part of that.
